brief:
Ma'an Wire has obtained details of proposals by Israeli political parties outlining plans for the West Bank that include annexation and expanded settlement construction, according to reporting on party platforms ahead of upcoming political developments in Israel.

The specifics of these party plans reflect ongoing Israeli political debate over the status and future governance of Palestinian territories. Divisions within Israeli politics over settlement policy and territorial control in the occupied West Bank have sharpened as parties prepare their electoral positions.
title: Israeli parties unveil plans for West Bank annexation and settlement expansion
